english: I disagree with the second part of your reason above: it's not true that something which is not related to existence must not be contradictory to what is not contradictory to existence. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then that which is not related to existence. It is too something which is not contradictory to what is not contradictory to existence, Because there does exist an example of something which is both it, and also not itself contradictory to existence.
